title: Entry window 00:00-15:30 (instead of 02:00), one winner passes, room 60%
question: Owner order 2026-10-18: an MFFU 50K eval must be passed within 10 sessions; maximise P(pass in 10) and minimise $91.80 / P(pass in 10).
verdict: Earlier window: H1 51.3% (vs 52.9), H2 47.8% (vs 50.7): not better in either half at this size. 50K: H1 starts (pick) pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 51.3/7.6/41.1% (n 119), within 20 70.6/17.4%, cost per 2-week pass $179.0, worst day $-1,008, max at risk $987; H2 starts (check) pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 47.8/2.9/49.3% (n 69), within 20 54.2/3.4%, cost per 2-week pass $192.0, worst day $-1,007, max at risk $992; 2026 pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 47.7/5.6/46.7% (n 197), within 20 58.8/15.0%, cost per 2-week pass $192.0, worst day $-1,008, max at risk $992; Monte Carlo 4,000 x 20 sessions (5-session blocks): H1 47.9/5.2/46.9, H2 57.8/3.5/38.7; 2021-25 reference (5m) 16.2/6.5. Back to back (new eval after a pass, a fail or 10 sessions): 2026 17 passes in 31 evals ($167 a pass), 2021-25 23 in 124 ($495). 25K ($63, every $ halved): H1 52.1/13.4, H2 53.6/4.3, cost per 2-week pass H1 $121.0 / H2 $118.0.
method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
